# Veterans Transition Assistant
> AI-powered curriculum creator and interview simulator helping veterans transition from military to civilian life through guided conversations and structured learning paths.

**Key Capabilities:**
- Dynamic curriculum generation based on veteran's background and goals
- Realistic interview practice with industry-specific scenarios
- Voice-driven interaction with contextual script guidance
- Comprehensive transition resources and knowledge base

## Voice Agent Scripts
- [Conversation Flow Scripts](/scripts/conversation-flows.md): Structured dialogue patterns for different scenarios
- [Interview Scenarios](/scripts/interview-scenarios.md): Industry-specific interview simulations and responses
- [Curriculum Progression](/scripts/curriculum-progression.md): Step-by-step learning path instructions
- [Assessment Scripts](/scripts/assessment-scripts.md): Evaluation and feedback delivery patterns
- [Crisis Response](/scripts/crisis-response.md): Supportive language for challenging conversations

## Curriculum Creation
- [Curriculum Templates](/curriculum/templates.md): Pre-built learning paths by career field
- [Skill Mapping](/curriculum/skill-mapping.md): Military to civilian skill translation
- [Learning Objectives](/curriculum/learning-objectives.md): Goal-setting frameworks
- [Progress Tracking](/curriculum/progress-tracking.md): Milestone and achievement guidelines
- [Customization Guide](/curriculum/customization.md): How to adapt curricula to individual needs

## Interview Simulator
- [Interview Types](/interview/types.md): Behavioral, technical, and panel interview formats
- [Industry Scenarios](/interview/industries.md): Sector-specific interview guidance (tech, healthcare, trades, etc.)
- [Question Banks](/interview/questions.md): Common interview questions with military-context answers
- [Feedback Framework](/interview/feedback.md): Constructive evaluation patterns
- [Follow-up Strategies](/interview/follow-up.md): Post-interview communication guidance

## Transition Resources
- [Career Fields](/resources/career-fields.md): Civilian career options by military specialty
- [Benefits Guide](/resources/benefits.md): VA benefits, GI Bill, and transition programs
- [Resume Builder](/resources/resume.md): Military to civilian resume translation
- [Networking Strategies](/resources/networking.md): Professional connection building
- [Education Pathways](/resources/education.md): Degree programs, certifications, and vocational training

- [Military Terminology Translation](/reference/terminology.md): MOS/Rating to civilian job title mapping
